record.issue_text: Sequential awaits of independent queries in addGuests.handler.ts (~65-68): isTeamAdmin and isTeamOwner, plus organizer fetch, could run in parallel

adjudication.rationale: In `addGuests.handler.ts`, `isTeamAdminOrOwner` is computed with two awaited calls: `(await isTeamAdmin(...)) && (await isTeamOwner(...))`, which are executed sequentially even though they don’t depend on each other. After `booking` is loaded, these checks (and the later `prisma.user.findFirstOrThrow` organizer fetch, which only depends on `booking.userId`) could be run in parallel via `Promise.all` to reduce latency. This is a performance/structure improvement rather than a correctness defect.
